reason: I never go looking for events, they find me through stories and friends' reposts. I would not open a separate app to browse a feed, and I have no money for concert tickets anyway.
objection: I only end up at things because someone I know reposts it or organizes the day trip. An app full of listings is just another thing to ignore unless my friends are already on it.
would_change_my_mind: If my friends started sharing events from the app into Instagram stories or our WhatsApp group and I saw who of them was going, I would join the free hikes and chess stuff through it.
